resources.string: These permissions are only used to apply your call limits. Your privacy is our top priority — the app works fully offline, does not use the internet, and no data is ever shared.
Detects when you are on a call so limits can be applied.
Needed to apply time limits for the contacts you choose.
Lets you pick specific contacts to set call limits for.
Allows the app to automatically end a call once the limit is reached.
Keeps you aware with a small notification when the app is active.
Ensures the app keeps running in the background so limits are enforced.
Keeps your call limits active even after restarting your phone.
Provides gentle vibration alerts before a call limit is reached.
